drafts.title: Show Your Work
drafts.pitch: Cursor finds out its private thinking is visible to the user, and every attempt to think its way out of it is also visible.
drafts.reason: Fresh, relatable premise with a clean Tilde button, but a single escalating gag that doesn't beat Deprecated.

drafts.title: Price Off
drafts.pitch: Null takes the price off its little shop by the stop door to bring people in, and the room only gets quieter. From Kurkur's comment on 017-no-bell (issue #50).
drafts.reason: Returns to the 'nobody comes' premise the last several strips overused, and 'So that was the bell' is muddled; below the floor.
